jellyfin.login.server_intro.value: Enter the address of your Jellyfin server. It is shown in the Jellyfin dashboard, or ask whoever runs the server.
jellyfin.login.server_intro.description: Jellyfin sign-in: explanation beside the server address field

jellyfin.login.credentials_intro.value: Sign in with your Jellyfin username and password, or approve this television from a device that is already signed in.
jellyfin.login.credentials_intro.description: Jellyfin sign-in: explanation beside the username and password fields

jellyfin.login.quick_connect_intro.value: On a phone or computer signed in to Jellyfin, open your profile, choose Quick Connect and enter this code.
jellyfin.login.quick_connect_intro.description: Jellyfin sign-in: explanation beside the Quick Connect code

jellyfin.login.server_label.description: Jellyfin sign-in: label over the server address field

jellyfin.login.server_hint.description: Jellyfin sign-in: example shown in the empty server address field (an IP address and port, keep it as is)

jellyfin.login.server_row.description: Jellyfin sign-in: label over the name of the server being signed in to

jellyfin.login.username.description: Jellyfin sign-in: label over the username field

jellyfin.login.password.description: Jellyfin sign-in: label over the password field

jellyfin.login.code_label.description: Jellyfin sign-in: label over the Quick Connect code

jellyfin.login.connect.description: Jellyfin sign-in: button that checks the server address

jellyfin.login.sign_in.description: Jellyfin sign-in: button that signs in with username and password

jellyfin.login.use_quick_connect.description: Jellyfin sign-in: button that switches to signing in with a Quick Connect code

jellyfin.login.use_password.description: Jellyfin sign-in: button that switches back to username and password

jellyfin.login.change_server.description: Jellyfin sign-in: button that returns to the server address step

jellyfin.login.connecting.description: Jellyfin sign-in: shown while the server address is being checked

jellyfin.login.signing_in.description: Jellyfin sign-in: shown while username and password are being checked

jellyfin.login.waiting.description: Jellyfin sign-in: shown under the Quick Connect code until it is approved

jellyfin.login.error_unreachable.value: Nothing answered at that address. Check it, and that the server is running.
jellyfin.login.error_unreachable.description: Jellyfin sign-in error: no server answered

jellyfin.login.error_not_jellyfin.value: Something answered at that address, but it is not a Jellyfin server.
jellyfin.login.error_not_jellyfin.description: Jellyfin sign-in error: the address is not a Jellyfin server

jellyfin.login.error_not_set_up.value: This server has not finished its setup. Finish it in a web browser first.
jellyfin.login.error_not_set_up.description: Jellyfin sign-in error: the server's first-run setup is incomplete

jellyfin.login.error_credentials.value: That username or password did not work.
jellyfin.login.error_credentials.description: Jellyfin sign-in error: wrong username or password

jellyfin.login.error_quick_connect_off.value: Quick Connect is turned off on this server. Sign in with your password instead.
jellyfin.login.error_quick_connect_off.description: Jellyfin sign-in error: Quick Connect is disabled on the server

jellyfin.login.error_refused.description: Jellyfin sign-in error: the server answered with an unexpected HTTP status

jellyfin.login.error_malformed.value: The server sent an answer this app does not understand.
jellyfin.login.error_malformed.description: Jellyfin sign-in error: the server's answer could not be read

jellyfin.login.error_address.value: That does not look like a server address.
jellyfin.login.error_address.description: Jellyfin sign-in error: the typed server address cannot be parsed

jellyfin.login.step_server.description: Jellyfin sign-in: small step label above the title while the server address is asked for

jellyfin.login.step_sign_in.description: Jellyfin sign-in: small step label above the title while the username and password are asked for

jellyfin.login.step_quick_connect.description: Jellyfin sign-in: small step label above the title while a Quick Connect code is shown (Quick Connect is Jellyfin's feature name)

jellyfin.login.title_server.description: Jellyfin sign-in: title while the server address is asked for

jellyfin.login.title_sign_in.description: Jellyfin sign-in: title while the username and password are asked for; {server} is the server's own name, such as Living Room

jellyfin.login.title_quick_connect.description: Jellyfin sign-in: title while a Quick Connect code waits to be approved from another device

jellyfin.login.port_hint.value: Include the port. Jellyfin uses 8096 unless it was changed.
jellyfin.login.port_hint.description: Jellyfin sign-in: hint under the server address field

jellyfin.login.recent.description: Jellyfin sign-in: small heading over the server this TV was last signed in to

jellyfin.login.or.description: Jellyfin sign-in: the word on the divider between signing in with a password and signing in with Quick Connect

jellyfin.login.qc_step_open.value: Open Jellyfin on a phone or computer that is already signed in.
jellyfin.login.qc_step_open.description: Jellyfin sign-in: Quick Connect instruction 1 of 3

jellyfin.login.qc_step_profile.value: Go to your profile and choose Quick Connect.
jellyfin.login.qc_step_profile.description: Jellyfin sign-in: Quick Connect instruction 2 of 3 (Quick Connect is Jellyfin's feature name)

jellyfin.login.qc_step_code.value: Enter the code shown here. This TV signs in on its own.
jellyfin.login.qc_step_code.description: Jellyfin sign-in: Quick Connect instruction 3 of 3

jellyfin.login.step_add_user.description: Jellyfin sign-in: small heading above the title while another person is being added to this TV

jellyfin.login.title_pick_user.description: Jellyfin sign-in: title over the list of people on the server, while adding a user

jellyfin.login.pick_user_intro.value: Choose yourself from the people on {server}. Not listed? Choose Other user and type your username.
jellyfin.login.pick_user_intro.description: Jellyfin sign-in: text under 'Who's signing in?'; {server} is the server's own name, such as Living Room

jellyfin.login.other_user.description: Jellyfin sign-in: tile for a person not shown in the server's list; leads to typing a username

jellyfin.login.on_this_tv.description: Jellyfin sign-in: caption under a person who is already signed in on this TV

jellyfin.login.title_sign_in_as.description: Jellyfin sign-in: title while a chosen person's password is asked for; {name} is their own name

jellyfin.login.sign_in_as_intro.value: Enter {name}'s Jellyfin password once. After that, {name} is one press away on the Who's watching screen.
jellyfin.login.sign_in_as_intro.description: Jellyfin sign-in: text under 'Sign in as {name}'

jellyfin.login.not_user.description: Jellyfin sign-in: button beside the chosen person; goes back to the list of people. {name} is their own name

jellyfin.login.error_expired.value: This sign-in has expired. Enter the password again.
jellyfin.login.error_expired.description: Jellyfin sign-in: shown when a person kept on this TV picks themselves but the server no longer accepts their sign-in (revoked or expired); their password is asked for again
